posts.text:
The good news of course is that obesity isn't a condition that just randomly strikes people. Outside of some rare cases, you can control it as much as you can control what you put in your mouth.

As long as your heart is beating it's never too late to get in better shape!

posts.text:
When someone says the US obesity rate is 40%+ people get upset, bring up outliers, and talk about how BMI is 'inaccurate'.

So recently, doctors suggested a new measure that also considers waist circumference, waist hip ratio, and body fat scans.

It estimates 70% are obese lol.
